en: A sepia-toned portrait photograph of a young man in a military uniform. The uniform features distinct insignia, including an Iron Cross at the neck, Luftwaffe (German Air Force) wings on the chest, and other military decorations. The background is plain, focusing attention on the subject. There is a small artist or photographer's signature (Rohs) visible in the lower right corner.
